title: FloorEvent
description: Payload of a sensor floor event in the session log (B3), validated before it is appended. `kind` equals the event's `type`; the writer checks that relation. The floor is Ring 0 (06 Ring 0 contents): a deterministic rule table on the host compares the candidate tree with the run's base commit, and a candidate cannot pass by adding a suppression, changing config discovery, replacing a test command or deleting a protected assertion.

checked.title: FloorChecked
checked.description: The floor checked the candidate tree. `verdict` is `reject` if and only if there is at least one finding; `truncated` is true when more findings were found than are listed.

rules.description: The rule table version, such as `floor-1`.

candidateTree.description: The candidate tree: the worktree's HEAD plus its working tree, without ignored files. Its objects need not be kept; the same content gives the same ID.

findings.description: The findings, sorted by path, line, rule and detail.

signalled.title: FloorSignalled
signalled.description: A floor detector's signals from the base-to-candidate changes (Q44): a direct dependency added, a major bump of one, a lockfile-only change. `final` is the authoritative check at the run's end, `early` a warning in the middle of a run that opens no decision. `materiality` is the rubric version and brief threshold that route each signal to a Brief or a Ruling (Q53).

candidateTree.description: The candidate tree the signals were found in, as in `floor.checked`.

signals.description: The signals, sorted by path, name and type.

lockfiles.description: The changed lockfiles as shown text, sorted by code unit without repeats: each Brief proposes one `footprint.file` for each, so replay recomputes its whole footprint.
lockfiles.$comment: Optional only for logs written before it (A-dep): replay checks a Brief's footprints past its dependency and manifest ones for format only when this is absent, and only if no `floor.signalled` with it precedes that event in the log. The writer always gives it. Order and repeats are replay's check: standalone validators take no uniqueItems.

finding.title: FloorFinding
finding.description: One rule that fired. `path` is absent only for a `floor.limits` finding about the whole change list; `line` is the 1-based line in the candidate file.

rule.title: FloorRule
rule.description: Rules of `floor-1` and `floor-2`. `assertion.removed` is `floor-1` only: `floor-2` replaces it with `protected.changed`, a finding for any change to a protected path. `floor.limits`: the change was too large to check, so the floor fails closed.

dependencyAdded.title: FloorDependencyAdded
dependencyAdded.description: A direct dependency in `field`: a runtime one in no runtime field of the base (a move from `devDependencies` counts), a dev one in no field of the base. Every specifier kind counts.

dependencyMajorBump.title: FloorDependencyMajorBump
dependencyMajorBump.description: A changed specifier of a direct dependency against the same field of the base or, for a runtime field the base lacks it in, the base's first runtime field with it (OQ-AD-10b): `major` if the major key differs; `unknown` if either side gives none (OQ-AD-2), the `npm:` alias target or `workspace:` source changed (OQ-AD-10a), or an upper bound or open-endedness changed (OQ-AD-9).

lockfileOnly.title: FloorLockfileOnly
lockfileOnly.description: A changed lockfile, when no manifest in the change changed a dependency field.

signalId.description: `<floor.signalled eventId>:<index>`; it fits the object events' `signalId` (at most 128 code units).
signalId.$comment: The event-ID part is capped at 123 code units (1 + 122), so with `:` and a 3-digit index the ID fits 128; event IDs are UUIDs today.

dependencyField.description: The manifest field: the runtime fields and `devDependencies`.

oid.description: A full lowercase hex git object ID (SHA-1 or SHA-256).

path.description: A repo-relative path escaped for display: 1 to 8192 code points without C0 or C1 controls, format characters, line or paragraph separators or lone surrogates, not absolute and without empty, `.` or `..` segments.

text.description: Escaped display text: 1 to 8192 code points without C0 or C1 controls, format characters, line or paragraph separators or lone surrogates.

specifier.description: A dependency specifier escaped for display, as `text` but possibly empty.
